high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from the Wired.com website, taken at 8:02 AM, as indicated by the status bar at the top of the screen. The page features an article about Steve Jobs, with the headline partially visible at the top. The main body of the text discusses how Steve Jobs, despite his usual practice of delivering speeches without notes, chose to read from printed sheets during this particular event. The text mentions that the audience was unfamiliar with the venue, which was uncomfortable for Steve Jobs, who was wearing a graduation gown instead of his usual Issey Miyake turtleneck.
